verdict.rationale: Phaser's installation docs describe an official CLI that offers an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games, then downloads and configures the chosen package. That makes it an official CLI, but its documented scope is project scaffolding only, driven by interactive questions, with nothing showing it suits scripted or agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: non-interactive or flag-driven usage suitable for agents, commands beyond scaffolding (build, run, publish), detailed CLI reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
